title: Uniqueness of admissible periodic hard-sphere Boltzmann evolution
exact_target: For every nonnegative initial density on $T^3×R^3$ with compact velocity support and finite mass, kinetic energy and absolute entropy, must the periodic hard-sphere Boltzmann equation have at most one global admissible renormalized solution satisfying the source mass, momentum, energy and entropy conditions, strong L1 continuity and integrable gain and loss on a common initial interval?
